scenicChapters.title: Furka Pass
scenicChapters.narrative: The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 2478 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance — cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Furka Pass
scenicChapters.narrative: For 26 km this is Furka Pass, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it. Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

nufenen-pass-road.story: A 57 km one-way ride from near Formazza, about 58 min of riding. The stops in between: Nufenen Pass and All Acqua. The highest point is about 2,500 m. Nufenen Pass is subject to seasonal closure - check it is open before you set off. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.
